note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; scenario B never resolves the disputed link.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Two identical four-event chains; only link 2 → 3 differs (proposed in A, disputed in B with an alternative event put forward).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a five-event chain with two loss objects where the LAST link (event 5 → loss) is the one that differs, and no alternative barrier is supplied — B holds right before the loss and only the loss objects are unresolved.

scenarioA.caption: Last link (event 5 → loss) put forward as proposed

scenarioB.label: Disputed last link

params.changedFact: Only the last link differs: proposed in A, disputed in B
sharedFacts: Same five events in the same order

comparisonLabels.neutral: Shown for comparison; no outcome is stated for the disputed link

events.label: Delivery crate left partly blocking the main customer aisle overnight

Freestanding shelf unit behind the crate is jolted sideways
Ceramic display stand next to the shelf unit begins to wobble
Glass display cover on the stand slides towards the edge
Display cover falls against the pedestal holding the vase

alternatives.label: A customer leaning on the display stand shortly before the incident

losses.label: Hand-painted ceramic vase cracked (hypothetical value 1,200 units)
